lines.text: A square, a circle, a smaller square, a smaller circle.
lines.caption: A square, a circle, a smaller square, a smaller circle.

lines.text: Find the shaded ring! And no square roots needed!
lines.caption: Find the shaded ring! And no square roots needed!

lines.text: A circle fits in a square of side eight. A smaller square has its corners on that circle, with a smaller circle inside it.
lines.caption: A circle fits in a square of side eight. A smaller square has its corners on that circle, with a smaller circle inside it.

lines.text: What is the area of the shaded ring?
lines.caption: What is the area of the shaded ring?

lines.text: Look! The small square's corners sit at the middle of each side.
lines.caption: Look! The small square's corners sit at the middle of each side.

lines.text: Fold the four corner triangles in. They cover the small square exactly!
lines.caption: Fold the four corner triangles in. They cover the small square exactly!

lines.text: So the small square is half the big one, and its circle is half too!
lines.caption: So the small square is half the big one, and its circle is half too!

lines.text: The big circle is sixteen pi. The small circle is half of that, eight pi.
lines.caption: The big circle is sixteen pi. The small circle is half of that, eight pi.

lines.text: So the ring is the other half. Eight pi, choice B!
lines.caption: So the ring is the other half. Eight pi, choice B!

lines.text: Why half? The full lesson shows the fold and the turn, plus every trap.
lines.caption: Why half? The full lesson shows the fold and the turn, plus every trap.
